methodology.inner_role: Hyperparameter selection and preprocessing fit on outer-training rows only
methodology.outer_role: Pure evaluation only; hyperparameters are never selected on outer-test rows

feature_label_permutation_null.null: fixed reference magnitudes with randomly permuted feature labels
feature_label_permutation_null.scope: descriptive label-permutation benchmark; feature exchangeability is not assumed as a population model

fold_level_stability.caveat: Outer folds contain few projects, fold test compositions differ, and the 1,225 fold pairs are dependent; repeat-level pooled rankings are the primary joint-stability result.

interpretation_limits: SHAP decomposes model predictions relative to a chosen training background; it is not causal evidence.
Alignment with weighted-model SHAP is descriptive because the same weights are injected into that model.
Current feature weights are data-derived FAHP-inspired proxies, not an independent panel of expert judgments.
Correlated COCOMO drivers can redistribute attribution; dependence-aware sensitivity analysis remains future work.
The conditional project-resampling interval fixes the fitted repeated-CV models and does not include every source of uncertainty.
Joint repeat stability combines changes in split, fitted model, background, and KernelSHAP seed; numerical explainer sensitivity is reported separately.
explainability.joint_stability_scope: split, fitted model, outer-training background, and KernelSHAP seed vary together; this is joint resampling stability, not isolated model or explainer stability

numerical_sensitivity.feature_selection: disabled; all features enter the weighted least-squares solution
numerical_sensitivity.purpose: numerical explainer sensitivity with model, rows, and background held fixed
numerical_sensitivity.scope: in-sample numerical audit only; it is not predictive-performance or feature-reliance evidence

primary_alignment_project_bootstrap.method: project-level nonparametric percentile bootstrap, conditional on fitted repeated-CV models
primary_alignment_project_bootstrap.resampling_unit: COCOMO project after averaging its repeated out-of-fold explanations
primary_alignment_project_bootstrap.scope: conditional project-resampling interval; model fitting, split selection, tuning, and explainer uncertainty are not re-run

explainability.primary_comparison: training-derived weighting proxy versus unweighted-model out-of-fold SHAP reliance

protocol.background_source: outer-training partition only; outcomes are not used to select background rows
protocol.explained_rows: outer-test projects only; each project is explained once per repeat
protocol.explainer: model-agnostic KernelSHAP over the complete raw-input prediction pipeline
protocol.feature_selection: disabled; all 17 features enter the weighted least-squares solution
protocol.fold_audit: zero-based train/test/background row manifests and selected parameters are stored per fold

repeated_accuracy_descriptive.caveat: Repeated partitions overlap and are not independent inferential units; no uncorrected significance test is reported.

full_data_diagnostics.caveat: Chang extent analysis produces sparse project weights here; proxy-weight sensitivity and genuine expert elicitation remain required for a confirmatory study.

weighting_proxy.interpretation: supervised FAHP-inspired proxy, not an independent expert prior
weighting_proxy.method: Chang extent analysis on training-project effort/LOC, followed by absolute Spearman feature association

external_nasa93.role: external test; never used for selection

prediction_interval.source: pure nested outer-fold signed relative errors

effort_proxy.definition: unique author-days in sampled commits divided by 20

popularity_holdout.caveat: Popularity hold-out; repository stars are not a time variable
popularity_holdout.selection: inner 5-fold CV on high-star training partition only

prediction_interval.source: pure nested outer-fold signed relative errors
